crossRefs.note: When you reap your harvest in your field, and have forgotten a sheaf in the field, you shall not go again to get it. It…
“ ‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not wholly reap the corners of your field, neither shall you…
You shall not glean your vineyard, neither shall you gather the fallen grapes of your vineyard. You shall leave them…

parallels.note: “You shall not take advantage of any widow or fatherless child.
They kill the widow and the alien, and murder the fatherless.

translations.web: When you harvest your vineyard, you shall not glean it after yourselves. It shall be for the foreigner, for the fatherless, and for the widow.
translations.bsb: When you gather the grapes of your vineyard, you must not go over the vines again. What remains will be for the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow.
translations.kjv: When thou gatherest the grapes of thy vineyard, thou shalt not glean it afterward: it shall be for the stranger, for the fatherless, and for the widow.
translations.asv: When thou gatherest the grapes of thy vineyard, thou shalt not glean it after thee: it shall be for the sojourner, for the fatherless, and for the widow.
